note_en: 既不 A，也不 B means "neither A nor B": both options are ruled out. 既 and 也 each sit before one of the two negatives, and the halves are built in parallel. In the text: 既不得罪人，也不委屈自己 "without offending anyone or shortchanging himself." With a modal verb the pattern is the same: 既不要把自己卷成一张折叠床，也不要把工作当成人生唯一的意义 "don't grind yourself down into a folding cot, and don't treat work as the only meaning in life."
